Fix: added fresh_float() in the dynamic runtime, which gives every *computed* NaN result a fresh payload (passthroughs like assignment, unary +, float(x), max/min keep their bits), and applied it to float_fast (+,-,*,/), float_op (//,%,**), unary neg, abs/__abs__, sum, round(nan,n) and every math function; values-view containment now checks is() before eq(); `is` on non-NaN floats compares bits again (x is x stays True as on main) while NaN identity stays payload-based. The typed guard (nan_cmp) now also tracks may-be-NaN values (arithmetic from NaN sources, inf-inf, inf/inf, inf*0, 0/0, 0**negative, inf%, inf//, max/min/abs/round/sum/math calls, augassign), infinity sources and dict views, and refuses in/==/!=/is on them so the typed build hands those programs to the (now correct) dynamic build. Extended tests/lib/review_m08_nan_in_list.py with the reviewer's cases and its .expected from python3; added changelog.d/review-m08.md. Tested: all reviewer cases plus dict/set/tuple/deque/json/max/min/sum/pow/round/passthrough cases match CPython in the normal and BREVI_DYN=1 builds; run_check passes (target goes dynamic, 40/40 guard programs still typed); ordinary float code still builds typed. Hot-path cost is one predictable is_nan() branch on the op result, taken only for NaN results.
